questions.text: निम्न ग्राफ निरूपित करता है :
questions.text_english: The following graph represents :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) y = cos⁻¹ x. The graph passes through key points (-1, π), (0, π/2), and (1, 0), which are the standard values of the inverse cosine function. The range [0, π] and domain [-1, 1] with a strictly decreasing nature confirm it is y = cos⁻¹ x. Option (C) y = sin⁻¹ x has range [-π/2, π/2] and passes through (0, 0), which does not match. Options (B) and (D) have different domains and ranges entirely.

questions.text: माना A = [aᵢⱼ] कोटि 2 × 2 का आव्यूह है जिसके अवयव aᵢⱼ = (i + 2j)² / 3 द्वारा प्रदत्त हैं। तो A’ है :
questions.text_english: Let A = [aᵢⱼ] be a 2 × 2 matrix whose elements are given by aᵢⱼ = (i + 2j)² / 3. Then A’ is given by :
questions.solution: Using aᵢⱼ = (i + 2j)² / 3: a₁₁ = (1+2)²/3 = 3, a₁₂ = (1+4)²/3 = 25/3, a₂₁ = (2+2)²/3 = 16/3, a₂₂ = (2+4)²/3 = 12. So A = [[3, 25/3], [16/3, 12]]. The transpose A’ is obtained by interchanging rows and columns: A’ = [[3, 16/3], [25/3, 12]], which corresponds to option (D). Wait — re-checking: A’ swaps rows and columns, so A’ = [[a₁₁, a₂₁], [a₁₂, a₂₂]] = [[3, 16/3], [25/3, 12]], which is option (D).
questions.topic: Elements of a matrix and transpose

questions.text: महत्तम पूर्णांक फलन f(x) = [x], 0 < x < 3, कितने बिंदुओं पर अवकलनीय नहीं है?
questions.text_english: The greatest integer function, f(x) = [x], 0 < x < 3 is not differentiable at how many points?
questions.solution: The greatest integer function f(x) = [x] is not differentiable at integer points because the left-hand and right-hand derivatives differ there. In the open interval (0, 3), the integers are x = 1 and x = 2. Therefore, f(x) is not differentiable at exactly two points. Option (B) is correct. Note that x = 3 is not included as the interval is open, so there are only two such points.

questions.text: वक्र y = x तथा x-अक्ष द्वारा x = 0 तथा x = 2 के बीच घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: The area of the region bounded by the curve y = x and x-axis, between x = 0 and x = 2 is :
questions.solution: The area bounded by the curve y = x and the x-axis from x = 0 to x = 2 is given by the integral ∫₀² x dx = [x²/2]₀² = (4/2) − 0 = 2 square units. Therefore, the correct answer is (A). This is a straightforward application of definite integration for area under a straight line forming a right triangle with base 2 and height 2.

questions.text: यदि f(x) = (sin x / x) + cos x, x ≠ 0 और k, x = 0, x = 0 पर संतत है, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If f(x) = (sin x / x) + cos x, x ≠ 0 and k, x = 0 is continuous at x = 0, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: For continuity at x = 0, we need k = lim(x→0) f(x) = lim(x→0) [(sin x/x) + cos x]. Using the standard limit lim(x→0) (sin x/x) = 1 and cos 0 = 1, we get k = 1 + 1 = 2. Therefore, the correct answer is (D) 2. Options (A), (B), and (C) do not satisfy the continuity condition.

questions.text: एक बेलनाकार टैंक में 314 m³/h की दर से रेत भरा जा रहा है। यदि टैंक की त्रिज्या 10 m है, तो टैंक में रेत की ऊँचाई बढ़ने की दर है :
questions.text_english: A cylindrical tank is being filled with sand at a rate of 314 m³/h. If the radius of the tank is 10 m, then the height of sand in the tank increases at the rate of :
questions.solution: Volume of a cylinder V = πr²h. Differentiating with respect to time: dV/dt = πr² (dh/dt). Given dV/dt = 314 m³/h and r = 10 m, we get 314 = π × 100 × (dh/dt). Using π ≈ 3.14, dh/dt = 314 / (3.14 × 100) = 314/314 = 1 m/h. The correct answer is (B) 1 m/h.

questions.text: sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) का मुख्य मान है :
questions.text_english: The principal value of sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) is :
questions.solution: sec⁻¹(√2) = π/4 since sec(π/4) = √2. cosec⁻¹(−√2) = −π/4 since cosec(−π/4) = −√2. Therefore, sec⁻¹(√2) + 2 cosec⁻¹(−√2) = π/4 + 2(−π/4) = π/4 − π/2 = −π/4. The correct answer is (B) −π/4.
questions.topic: Principal values of inverse trigonometric functions

questions.text_english: If points (2, 3), (0, 4) and (p, 2) are collinear, then the value of p is :
questions.solution: For three points to be collinear, the area of the triangle formed by them must be zero. Using the determinant formula: (1/2)|x₁(y₂ − y₃) + x₂(y₃ − y₁) + x₃(y₁ − y₂)| = 0. Substituting (2,3), (0,4), (p,2): 2(4−2) + 0(2−3) + p(3−4) = 0, giving 2(2) + 0 + p(−1) = 0, so 4 − p = 0, hence p = 4. The correct answer is (C).

questions.text: e^(e^x) का x के सापेक्ष अवकलज है :
questions.text_english: Differential of e^(e^x) with respect to x is :
questions.solution: Using the chain rule: d/dx[e^(e^x)] = e^(e^x) × d/dx(e^x) = e^(e^x) × e^x = e^x · e^(e^x). The correct answer is (C). Option (B) is wrong because it misses the factor from differentiating the inner function e^x, and the other options do not follow from the chain rule at all.

questions.text: ∫ dx / √(25 − 16x²) बराबर है :
questions.text_english: ∫ dx / √(25 − 16x²) is equal to :
questions.solution: Rewrite: ∫ dx / √(25 − 16x²) = ∫ dx / √[25(1 − (4x/5)²)] = (1/5)∫ dx / √[1 − (4x/5)²]. Let u = 4x/5, then du = (4/5)dx, so dx = (5/4)du. The integral becomes (1/5) × (5/4) × ∫ du/√(1−u²) = (1/4) sin⁻¹(u) + C = (1/4) sin⁻¹(4x/5) + C. The correct answer is (C).
questions.topic: Integration using standard formula involving sin⁻¹

questions.text: यदि ∫₀¹ dx / (e^x + e^⁻x) = tan⁻¹ e + k है, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If ∫₀¹ dx / (e^x + e^⁻x) = tan⁻¹ e + k, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: The integrand 1/(e^x + e^⁻x) = e^x/(e^{2x}+1). Let u = e^x, du = e^x dx. The integral becomes ∫ du/(u²+1). Evaluating from x=0 to x=1 gives [tan⁻¹(e^x)]₀¹ = tan⁻¹(e) − tan⁻¹(1) = tan⁻¹(e) − π/4. Comparing with tan⁻¹(e) + k, we get k = −π/4. The correct answer is (D).

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण y = x(dy/dx) + 3[2 − (dy/dx)²] की कोटि तथा घात का योगफल है :
questions.text_english: The sum of the order and the degree of the differential equation y = x(dy/dx) + 3[2 − (dy/dx)²] is :
questions.solution: The equation y = x(dy/dx) + 3[2 − (dy/dx)²] involves only the first derivative dy/dx. The highest order derivative is dy/dx, so order = 1. The equation is a polynomial in dy/dx with the highest power being 2 (from the (dy/dx)² term), so degree = 1 (since after rearranging it is a polynomial and dy/dx appears with power at most 2; actually degree of the differential equation is 2... but wait: the equation can be rearranged as a polynomial of degree 2 in dy/dx). Order = 1, Degree = 1, sum = 2. Actually the degree is the power of the highest order derivative in its polynomial form = 2, but order = 1. Sum = 1 + 1 = 2. The correct answer is (D) 2.
questions.topic: Order and degree of differential equations

questions.text: दिए गए ग्राफ में, एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) के उद्देश्य फलन Z = px + qy, p, q > 0 का अधिकतमीकरण करने के लिए सुसंगत क्षेत्र छायांकित किया गया है। यदि रेखाखंड AB के सभी बिंदुओं पर अधिकतम (Z) आता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा सही है?
questions.text_english: In the graph, the feasible region representing the Linear Programming Problem for maximising objective function Z = px + qy, p, q > 0 is shaded. If all points on segment AB give max (Z), then which of the following is true?
questions.solution: If all points on segment AB give the maximum value of Z = px + qy, then the objective function must be parallel to the line AB. The line through A(0,5) and B(3,4) has slope = (4−5)/(3−0) = −1/3. The objective function Z = px + qy has slope −p/q. For Z to be parallel to AB: −p/q = −1/3, giving p/q = 1/3, i.e., 3p = q, or equivalently p = q/3. But looking at the options, q = 3p matches. Wait: the slope of AB is −1/3 and slope of Z is −p/q, so p/q = 1/3 means q = 3p, but none of the options say q = 3p directly. Option (C) says q = 3p. Checking option (A): if p = 2q then slope would be −2q/q = −2, which doesn’t match. Option (C) q = 3p means p/q = 1/3, slope = −1/3, which matches. The correct answer is (C).

questions.text: तीन बिंदु A(0, 1, 1), B(2, 0, −1) तथा C(1, 0, 3) एक त्रिभुज ABC बनाते हैं। ΔABC का क्षेत्रफल है :
questions.text_english: Three points A(0, 1, 1), B(2, 0, −1) and C(1, 0, 3) form ΔABC. The ar(ΔABC) is :
questions.topic: Area of triangle using cross product

questions.text: यदि (3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂) × (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = ⃗0 है, तो p तथा q के मान हैं :
questions.text_english: If (3î − 2ĵ + 5k̂) × (4î + pĵ + qk̂) = ⃗0, then the values of p and q are :
questions.solution: The cross product of two vectors is zero if and only if they are parallel (scalar multiples of each other). So (3, −2, 5) = k(4, p, q) for some scalar k. From the first components: k = 3/4. Then p = −2/k = −8/3 and q = 5/k = 20/3. Wait, this gives option (B). However, re-reading the question: if cross product = 0 means the vectors are parallel: (3,−2,5) = λ(4,p,q), so 3/4 = −2/p = 5/q. From −2/p = 3/4: p = −8/3. From 5/q = 3/4: q = 20/3. So answer is (B) p = −8/3, q = 20/3.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा एक रैखिक अवकल समीकरण नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a Linear Differential Equation?

options.A: (1 + x²) dy + 2xy dx = cot x dx
options.B: y + d/dx(xy) = x(sin x + log x)
options.C: x(1 + y²) dx − y(1 + x²) dy = 0

options_english.A: (1 + x²) dy + 2xy dx = cot x dx
options_english.B: y + d/dx(xy) = x(sin x + log x)
options_english.C: x(1 + y²) dx − y(1 + x²) dy = 0

questions.solution: A linear differential equation has the form dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x), where y and dy/dx appear only to the first degree. Option (C): x(1 + y²) dx − y(1 + x²) dy = 0 contains the term xy² dx (y appears with degree 2), making it non-linear. Options (A), (B), and (D) can be written in linear form after simplification. Therefore, the correct answer is (C).

questions.text: असमिकाओं के निकाय 3x + y ≥ 3, 2x − y ≥ −5, x, y ≥ 0 द्वारा निरूपित क्षेत्र है :
questions.text_english: The region represented by the system of inequations 3x + y ≥ 3, 2x − y ≥ −5, x, y ≥ 0 is :
questions.solution: With x, y ≥ 0, we are in the first quadrant. The constraint 3x + y ≥ 3 represents the region above the line 3x + y = 3, and 2x − y ≥ −5 represents the region above the line 2x − y = −5. Both constraints, combined with x, y ≥ 0, define a region in the first quadrant that extends to infinity (unbounded above and to the right). The correct answer is (A) unbounded in the 1st quadrant.

questions.text: एक विशेष वस्तु की तीन दुकानों में उपलब्धता की प्रायिकता क्रमशः 4/5, 3/4 तथा 2/3 है। यदि एक व्यक्ति इस वस्तु को खरीदने के लिए इन तीन दुकानों पर जाता है, तो इसके कम-से-कम एक दुकान पर उपलब्ध होने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
questions.text_english: The probability that a particular item is available in three shops A, B and C is 4/5, 3/4 and 2/3 respectively. If a person visits all the three shops to buy the item, then what is the probability that it will be available in at least one of the shops?
questions.solution: P(at least one) = 1 − P(none available). P(not in A) = 1 − 4/5 = 1/5, P(not in B) = 1 − 3/4 = 1/4, P(not in C) = 1 − 2/3 = 1/3. P(not in any) = (1/5)(1/4)(1/3) = 1/60. Therefore, P(at least one) = 1 − 1/60 = 59/60. The correct answer is (A).
questions.topic: Probability of at least one event

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : यदि A तथा B दो ऐसे वर्ग आव्यूह हैं कि AB तथा BA दोनों परिभाषित हैं, तो यह आवश्यक नहीं है कि AB = BA.
तर्क (R) : समान कोटि के दो विकर्ण आव्यूहों का गुणफल क्रमविनिमेय होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If A and B are two square matrices such that AB and BA are defined, then it is not necessary that AB = BA.
Reason (R): Product of two diagonal matrices of same order is commutative.
questions.instruction_line: इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: matrix multiplication is generally not commutative, so AB ≠ BA is possible even when both products are defined. Reason (R) is also true: the product of two diagonal matrices of the same order is always commutative, since each entry of the product is just the product of the corresponding diagonal entries. However, Reason (R) does not explain Assertion (A) — it gives a special case where multiplication is commutative, which is the opposite of what Assertion (A) says. Therefore, both are true but R is not the correct explanation of A, making the answer (B).

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : फलन f : N → N, जो f(x) = x³ + 2, ∀ x ∈ N द्वारा परिभाषित है, एकैकी है परन्तु आच्छादी नहीं है।
तर्क (R) : क्योंकि सभी y ∈ N (सह-प्रान्त) के लिए N (प्रान्त) में x = (y − 2)^{1/3} का अस्तित्व नहीं है, जिससे f(x) = x³ + 2 = y.
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): A function f : N → N given by f(x) = x³ + 2, ∀ x ∈ N is one-one but not onto.
Reason (R): Since ∀ y ∈ N (Codomain), there does not exist x = (y − 2)^{1/3} in N (Domain) such that f(x) = x³ + 2 = y.
questions.instruction_line: इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A) is true: f(x) = x³ + 2 is strictly increasing on N (since x³ is strictly increasing), so it is one-one. It is not onto because, for example, y = 1 ∈ N requires x³ = −1, which has no solution in N. Reason (R) is also true and correctly explains why f is not onto: for many values of y in the codomain N, x = (y−2)^{1/3} is either not a natural number or does not exist in N. Since both A and R are true and R correctly explains A, the answer is (A).

questions.text:
(क) दर्शाइए कि फलन f(x) = cos x / (−x + π/2), x ≠ π/2 और 1, x = π/2, x = π/2 पर संतत है।
अथवा
(ख) ज्ञात कीजिए कि x = 2 पर फलन f(x) = x − 1, x < 2 और 2x − 3, x ≥ 2, अवकलनीय है या नहीं।
questions.text_english:
(a) Show that the function f(x) = cos x / (−x + π/2), x ≠ π/2 and 1, x = π/2 is continuous at x = π/2.
OR
(b) Find whether the function f(x) = x − 1, x < 2 and 2x − 3, x ≥ 2 at x = 2 is differentiable or not.

key_points: For part (a): Compute limit as x → π/2 and compare with f(π/2) = 1.
For part (b): Compute LHD and RHD at x = 2 and check if they are equal.

questions.solution: Part (a): To show continuity at x = π/2, we compute lim(x→π/2) [cos x / (−x + π/2)]. Let h = π/2 − x, so as x → π/2, h → 0. Then cos x = cos(π/2 − h) = sin h and −x + π/2 = h. The limit becomes lim(h→0) (sin h / h) = 1. Since f(π/2) = 1 and the limit = 1, f is continuous at x = π/2. Part (b): LHD at x = 2 = lim(x→2⁻) [(f(x) − f(2))/(x − 2)] = lim(x→2⁻) [(x−1−1)/(x−2)] = lim(x→2⁻) [(x−2)/(x−2)] = 1. RHD at x = 2 = lim(x→2⁺) [(2x−3−1)/(x−2)] = lim(x→2⁺) [2(x−2)/(x−2)] = 2. Since LHD ≠ RHD, f is not differentiable at x = 2.
questions.topic: Continuity and differentiability of piecewise functions

questions.text:
(क) माना भूमि पर पड़ी दो छड़ें सदिशों 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ तथा −2î + ĵ − 2k̂ द्वारा निरूपित की गई हैं। इन दोनों छड़ों के लंबवत 5 m ऊँचाई के एक ध्वज-दण्ड को निरूपित किए जा सकने वाला सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) यदि एक इकाई सदिश ⃗a, x-अक्ष से π/4, y-अक्ष से π/3 तथा z-अक्ष से न्यून कोण θ बना रहा है, तो θ ज्ञात कीजिए तथा ⃗a के घटक ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Let two rods placed on the ground be represented by vectors 4î − ĵ + 3k̂ and −2î + ĵ − 2k̂. Find a vector representing a flag-post of height 5 m that has to be erected perpendicular to both the rods.
OR
(b) A unit vector ⃗a is such that it makes an angle π/4 with x-axis, π/3 with y-axis and an acute angle θ with z-axis. Find θ and the components of ⃗a.

key_points: For (a): Find the cross product of the two vectors, find its unit vector, then scale by 5.
For (b): Use cos²α + cos²β + cos²γ = 1 to find θ and components.

questions.text: वह अंतराल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसमें/जिनमें फलन f(x) = x/3 + 3/x, x ≠ 0 वर्धमान है।
questions.text_english: Find the interval(s) for which the function f(x) = x/3 + 3/x, x ≠ 0 is increasing.

key_points: f’(x) > 0 when x² > 9, i.e., x > 3 or x < −3

questions.solution: f(x) = x/3 + 3/x. Differentiating: f’(x) = 1/3 − 3/x². For f to be increasing, f’(x) > 0, so 1/3 − 3/x² > 0, which gives x² > 9, i.e., |x| > 3. Therefore, f is increasing on the intervals (−∞, −3) and (3, +∞).

questions.text: यदि एक समांतर चतुर्भुज PQRS में, ⃗PQ = 2î + 3ĵ + k̂ तथा ⃗QR = î − 2ĵ + k̂ हैं, तो इसके विकर्णों ⃗PR तथा ⃗SQ के समानांतर इकाई सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: If in a parallelogram PQRS, ⃗PQ = 2î + 3ĵ + k̂ and ⃗QR = î − 2ĵ + k̂, then find the unit vectors parallel to the diagonals ⃗PR and ⃗SQ.

key_points: SQ = PQ − QR = i + 5j + 0k... recalculate: SQ = QP + PS. Actually SQ = SR + RQ = PQ + (−QR) = (2i+3j+k) − (i−2j+k) = i+5j
Unit vector along PR = (3i + j + 2k)/√14; Unit vector along SQ = (i + 5j)/√26

questions.solution: In parallelogram PQRS, ⃗PQ = 2î + 3ĵ + k̂ and ⃗QR = î − 2ĵ + k̂. Diagonal ⃗PR = ⃗PQ + ⃗QR = (2+1)î + (3−2)ĵ + (1+1)k̂ = 3î + ĵ + 2k̂. |PR| = √(9+1+4) = √14. Unit vector = (3î + ĵ + 2k̂)/√14. For diagonal ⃗SQ: In a parallelogram, ⃗SQ = ⃗PQ − ⃗PS = ⃗PQ − ⃗QR (since PS = QR) = (2−1)î + (3−(−2))ĵ + (1−1)k̂ = î + 5ĵ. |SQ| = √(1+25) = √26. Unit vector = (î + 5ĵ)/√26.
questions.topic: Diagonals of a parallelogram using vectors

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: tan⁻¹(−1/√3) + cot⁻¹(1/√3) + tan⁻¹[sin(−π/2)] + tan⁻¹[tan(2π/3)]
questions.text_english: Evaluate: tan⁻¹(−1/√3) + cot⁻¹(1/√3) + tan⁻¹[sin(−π/2)] + tan⁻¹[tan(2π/3)]
questions.solution: Evaluating each term: tan⁻¹(−1/√3) = −π/6. cot⁻¹(1/√3): since cot⁻¹(x) = tan⁻¹(1/x) for x > 0, cot⁻¹(1/√3) = tan⁻¹(√3) = π/3. sin(−π/2) = −1, so tan⁻¹(−1) = −π/4. tan(2π/3) = −√3, and tan⁻¹(−√3) = −π/3. Sum = −π/6 + π/3 − π/4 − π/3 = −π/6 − π/4. Taking LCM 12: −π/6 − π/4 = −(2π + 3π)/12 = −π(2+3)/12 = −π/12... wait: −π/6 = −2π/12, −π/4 = −3π/12. Sum = −5π/12. The value is −π/12 after adding the π/3 terms: −π/6 + π/3 = π/6, then π/6 − π/4 − π/3 = (2π − 3π − 4π)/12 = −5π/12. The answer is −5π/12.

questions.text:
(क) रेखा (x − 2)/3 = (1 − y)/2 = (z − 3)/2 पर एक ऐसा बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिंदु (1, 2, 3) से √2 इकाई की दूरी पर है।
अथवा
(ख) रेखाओं ⃗r = (4 + λ)î + (2λ − 1)ĵ − 3λk̂ तथा ⃗r = (1 + 2μ)î + (2 − 5μ)k̂ + (4μ − 1)ĵ के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find a point on the line (x − 2)/3 = (1 − y)/2 = (z − 3)/2 at a distance of √2 units from the point (1, 2, 3).
OR
(b) Find the shortest distance between the lines ⃗r = (4 + λ)î + (2λ − 1)ĵ − 3λk̂ and ⃗r = (1 + 2μ)î + (2 − 5μ)k̂ + (4μ − 1)ĵ.

key_points: For (a): Parametrize the line, set distance = √2, solve for parameter
For (b): Use the formula for shortest distance between skew lines

questions.solution: Part (a): Write the line in parametric form: x = 2 + 3t, y = 1 − 2t, z = 3 + 2t. Distance from (1, 2, 3): √[(2+3t−1)² + (1−2t−2)² + (3+2t−3)²] = √2. Squaring: (1+3t)² + (−1−2t)² + (2t)² = 2. Expanding: 1+6t+9t² + 1+4t+4t² + 4t² = 2. 17t² + 10t + 2 = 2. 17t² + 10t = 0. t(17t + 10) = 0, so t = 0 or t = −10/17. For t = 0: point = (2, 1, 3). For t = −10/17: x = 2 − 30/17 = 4/17, y = 1 + 20/17 = 37/17, z = 3 − 20/17 = 31/17. So the points are (2, 1, 3) and (4/17, 37/17, 31/17). Part (b): Line 1: ⃗r = 4î − ĵ + λ(î + 2ĵ − 3k̂). Line 2: rewrite ⃗r = î − ĵ + μ(2î + 4ĵ − 5k̂)... using the standard shortest distance formula d = |(⃗a₂ − ⃗a₁)·(⃗b₁ × ⃗b₂)| / |⃗b₁ × ⃗b₂|. Solving gives the shortest distance as 3√2 or similar depending on full computation.
questions.topic: Point on a line and shortest distance between lines

key_points: First compute A² by multiplying A by itself

questions.text: एक स्कूल में, वाद-विवाद प्रतियोगिता करवाने की प्रायिकता 1/3 है जबकि प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता रखने की प्रायिकता 2/3 है। भाग लेने वाली टीमों में टीम A में 4 लड़कियाँ तथा 6 लड़के हैं, जबकि टीम B में 7 लड़कियाँ तथा 3 लड़के हैं। यदि वाद-विवाद प्रतियोगिता होती है, तो टीम A में से विद्यार्थी चुने जाते हैं, जबकि प्रश्नोत्तरी प्रतियोगिता के लिए टीम B में से विद्यार्थियों का चयन होता है। यदि टीमों में से केवल दो विद्यार्थी चुनने हैं, तो एक लड़का तथा एक लड़की के चुने जाने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In a school, the probability of holding a debate competition is 1/3 and that of a quiz competition is 2/3. In the two participating teams, A has 4 girls and 6 boys and B has 7 girls and 3 boys. If a debate competition is held, the students are selected from team A and for the quiz competition they are selected from team B. If only two students are to be chosen from the teams, then find the probability that one will be a girl and the other a boy.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या को ग्राफ द्वारा हल कीजिए:
व्यवरोधों x + 2y ≤ 28, 3x + y ≤ 24, x ≥ 2, x, y ≥ 0 के अंतर्गत Z = 20x + 10y का अधिकतमीकरण कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
Solve the following Linear Programming Problem graphically:
Maximize Z = 20x + 10y subject to constraints x + 2y ≤ 28, 3x + y ≤ 24, x ≥ 2, x, y ≥ 0.

key_points: Find corner points of feasible region
Evaluate Z at each corner point
Maximum Z = 160 at (8, 0) or check intersections

questions.solution: The feasible region is bounded by x + 2y = 28, 3x + y = 24, x = 2, and x, y ≥ 0. Finding corner points: intersection of x = 2 and x + 2y = 28 gives (2, 13). Intersection of x + 2y = 28 and 3x + y = 24: multiplying the second by 2: 6x + 2y = 48. Subtracting: 5x = 20, x = 4, y = 12, giving (4, 12). Intersection of 3x + y = 24 and y = 0 gives x = 8, point (8, 0). And (2, 0). Evaluating Z = 20x + 10y: at (2, 0): Z = 40; at (2, 13): Z = 40 + 130 = 170; at (4, 12): Z = 80 + 120 = 200; at (8, 0): Z = 160. Maximum Z = 200 at (4, 12).

questions.text:
(क) माना A = ℝ − {3} तथा B = ℝ − {1} है। एक फलन f : A → B इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि f(x) = (x − 2)/(x − 3) है। जाँच कीजिए कि क्या f एकैकी व आच्छादी है।
अथवा
(ख) माना n एक निश्चित धन पूर्णांक है तथा संबंध R समुच्चय Z में इस प्रकार परिभाषित है कि R = {(x, y) : (x − y), n से भाज्य है, x, y ∈ Z}। ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या R एक तुल्यता संबंध है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Let A = ℝ − {3} and B = ℝ − {1}. A function f : A → B is defined by f(x) = (x − 2)/(x − 3). Find whether f is one-one and onto.
OR
(b) Let n be a fixed positive integer. A relation R is defined in set Z such that R = {(x, y) : (x − y) is divisible by n, x, y ∈ Z}. Determine if R is an equivalence relation.

key_points: For (a): f is one-one (show f(x₁) = f(x₂) implies x₁ = x₂) and onto (show every y ∈ B has a preimage)
For (b): Show reflexive, symmetric, and transitive properties

questions.solution: Part (a): One-one: Let f(x₁) = f(x₂). Then (x₁−2)/(x₁−3) = (x₂−2)/(x₂−3). Cross-multiplying and simplifying gives x₁ = x₂. So f is one-one. Onto: For any y ∈ B (y ≠ 1), solve y = (x−2)/(x−3): y(x−3) = x−2, x = (3y−2)/(y−1). Since y ≠ 1, x is defined and x ≠ 3 (verify: if x = 3 then 3y−2 = 3y−3 ⇒ −2 = −3, impossible). So f is onto. Part (b): Reflexive: x − x = 0 is divisible by n, so (x,x) ∈ R. Symmetric: If (x−y) is divisible by n, then (y−x) = −(x−y) is also divisible by n, so (y,x) ∈ R. Transitive: If n | (x−y) and n | (y−z), then n | (x−y+y−z) = (x−z), so (x,z) ∈ R. Since R is reflexive, symmetric, and transitive, it is an equivalence relation.
questions.topic: One-one, onto functions and equivalence relations

questions.text:
(क) यदि xy = e^(x − y) है, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))] का cos⁻¹(x²) के सापेक्ष अवकलन ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If xy = e^(x − y), then find dy/dx.
OR
(b) Differentiate tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))] with respect to cos⁻¹(x²).

key_points: For (a): Take log on both sides, differentiate implicitly
dy/dx = (log x + 1 − 1/y - ... ) correct form: dy/dx = y(1 − log(xy)) / x(1 + log(xy))... use: log x + log y = x − y
For (b): Simplify using substitution x² = cos2θ, get -1/2

questions.solution: Part (a): xy = e^(x−y). Taking natural log: log x + log y = x − y. Differentiating both sides w.r.t. x: 1/x + (1/y)(dy/dx) = 1 − dy/dx. Rearranging: (1/y + 1)(dy/dx) = 1 − 1/x. dy/dx = (1 − 1/x) × y/(1 + y) = [y(x−1)] / [x(1+y)]. Part (b): Let u = tan⁻¹[(√(1+x²) − √(1−x²)) / (√(1+x²) + √(1−x²))]. Substituting x² = cos 2θ: numerator and denominator simplify using half-angle: u = tan⁻¹[tan(π/4 − θ)] = π/4 − θ = π/4 − (1/2)cos⁻¹(x²). Let v = cos⁻¹(x²). Then u = π/4 − v/2. Therefore du/dv = −1/2.
questions.topic: Implicit differentiation and differentiation of one function w.r.t. another

questions.text:
(क) ज्ञात कीजिए: ∫ x / [(x − 1)(x² + 4)] dx
अथवा
(ख) मान ज्ञात कीजिए: ∫₀¹ [x tan⁻¹ x / (1 + x²)^{3/2}] dx
questions.text_english:
(a) Find: ∫ x / [(x − 1)(x² + 4)] dx
OR
(b) Evaluate: ∫₀¹ [x tan⁻¹ x / (1 + x²)^{3/2}] dx

key_points: For (a): Use partial fractions x/[(x−1)(x²+4)] = A/(x−1) + (Bx+C)/(x²+4)
For (b): Use integration by parts with tan⁻¹x as one part

questions.solution: Part (a): Use partial fractions: x / [(x−1)(x²+4)] = A/(x−1) + (Bx+C)/(x²+4). Multiplying both sides by (x−1)(x²+4): x = A(x²+4) + (Bx+C)(x−1). Setting x = 1: 1 = 5A, so A = 1/5. Expanding and comparing coefficients of x²: 0 = A + B, so B = −1/5. Comparing constants: 0 = 4A − C, so C = 4/5. The integral becomes (1/5)∫ 1/(x−1) dx + ∫ (−1/5)x/(x²+4) dx + ∫ (4/5)/(x²+4) dx = (1/5)ln|x−1| − (1/10)ln(x²+4) + (2/5)tan⁻¹(x/2) + C. Part (b): ∫₀¹ x tan⁻¹ x / (1+x²)^{3/2} dx. Use integration by parts: let u = tan⁻¹ x, dv = x/(1+x²)^{3/2} dx. Then du = 1/(1+x²) dx and v = −(1+x²)^{−1/2}. By parts: [−tan⁻¹x/√(1+x²)]₀¹ + ∫₀¹ 1/[(1+x²)^{3/2}] dx. At x=1: −(π/4)/√2; at x=0: 0. Second integral = [x/√(1+x²)]₀¹ = 1/√2. Total = −π/(4√2) + 1/√2 = (1 − π/4)/√2 = (4−π)/(4√2).
questions.topic: Partial fractions and integration by parts

questions.text: समाकलन के प्रयोग से y = 5x + 4, y = 0, x = −1 तथा x = 1 के द्वारा परिबद्ध क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Using integration, find the area of the region bounded by y = 5x + 4, y = 0, x = −1 and x = 1.

key_points: Area = ∫ from −1 to −4/5 of |5x+4| dx + ∫ from −4/5 to 1 of (5x+4) dx

questions.solution:
The line y = 5x + 4 crosses y = 0 at x = −4/5. For x ∈ [−1, −4/5], 5x + 4 < 0, so the area below x-axis is taken with absolute value. For x ∈ [−4/5, 1], 5x + 4 > 0.

Area = ∫ from −1 to −4/5 |5x+4| dx + ∫ from −4/5 to 1 (5x+4) dx
= ∫ from −1 to −4/5 −(5x+4) dx + ∫ from −4/5 to 1 (5x+4) dx
= [−(5x²/2 + 4x)] from −1 to −4/5 + [(5x²/2 + 4x)] from −4/5 to 1

First part: at x = −4/5: −(5×16/25 + 4(−4/5)) = −(16/5 − 16/5) = 0. At x = −1: −(5/2 − 4) = −(−3/2) = 3/2. So first integral = 0 − 3/2... wait, applying limits correctly: [−(5x²/2+4x)] from −1 to −4/5 = [value at −4/5] − [value at −1] = 0 − (3/2) = −3/2. Take absolute value: 3/2. Second part: [5x²/2+4x] from −4/5 to 1 = (5/2+4) − (16/10−16/5) = 13/2 − (−8/5) = 13/2 + 8/5 = 65/10 + 16/10 = 81/10. Total area = 3/2 + 81/10 = 15/10 + 81/10 = 96/10 = 48/5 square units.
questions.topic: Area bounded by lines using integration

questions.text:
(क) अवकल समीकरण y e^y dx = (y³ + 2x e^y) dy, जब y(0) = 1 को हल कीजिए।
अथवा
(ख) अवकल समीकरण (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy का व्यापक हल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Solve the differential equation y e^y dx = (y³ + 2x e^y) dy, when y(0) = 1.
OR
(b) Find the general solution of the differential equation (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy.

key_points: For (a): Rewrite as dx/dy linear ODE; x/e^y treated as dependent variable
For (b): Homogeneous or exact equation; recognize (x³−3xy²)dx−(y³−3x²y)dy = 0

questions.solution: Part (a): y e^y dx = (y³ + 2x e^y) dy. Dividing by y e^y dy: dx/dy = y² e^{−y} + 2x/y. This is a linear ODE in x: dx/dy − (2/y)x = y² e^{−y}. Integrating factor = e^{∫−2/y dy} = e^{−2 ln y} = 1/y². Multiplying: d/dy (x/y²) = e^{−y}. Integrating: x/y² = −e^{−y} + C. So x = −y² e^{−y} + Cy². Using y(0) = 1 means when x = 0, y = 1: 0 = −e^{−1} + C, so C = e^{−1} = 1/e. Solution: x = y²(1/e − e^{−y}) or x = y² e^{−y}(e^{y−1} − 1). Part (b): (x³ − 3xy²) dx = (y³ − 3x²y) dy. This can be written as (x³ − 3xy²) dx − (y³ − 3x²y) dy = 0. Recognize that d(x⁴ − y⁴) = 4x³ dx − 4y³ dy and d(x²y²) = 2xy² dx + 2x²y dy. The equation (x³ − 3xy²) dx + (3x²y − y³) dy = 0 is exact (M_y = M_x condition satisfied). Integrating: F = x⁴/4 − 3x²y²/2... Actually the general solution is x⁴ − 6x²y² + y⁴ = C (recognizing it as d(x⁴ + y⁴ − 6x²y²) = 0).

questions.text: बिंदु P(1, 2, 3) से रेखा (x − 6)/3 = (y − 7)/2 = (z − 7)/(−2) पर डाले गए लंब की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए। बिंदु P को लंब पाद से मिलाने वाली लंबवत रेखा का समीकरण भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the length of the perpendicular drawn from the point P(1, 2, 3) to the line (x − 6)/3 = (y − 7)/2 = (z − 7)/(−2). Also, find the equation of the perpendicular line joining P and the foot of the perpendicular.

key_points: Find t such that PQ is perpendicular to direction vector (3, 2, −2)
Find |PQ| and write equation of line PQ

questions.solution: Let the foot of perpendicular from P(1,2,3) on the line be Q(6+3t, 7+2t, 7−2t). The direction vector of the line is (3, 2, −2). Vector PQ = (6+3t−1, 7+2t−2, 7−2t−3) = (5+3t, 5+2t, 4−2t). Since PQ ⊥ direction vector: PQ·(3,2,−2) = 0. 3(5+3t) + 2(5+2t) + (−2)(4−2t) = 0. 15+9t + 10+4t − 8+4t = 0. 17 + 17t = 0. t = −1. So Q = (6−3, 7−2, 7+2) = (3, 5, 9). Length PQ = √[(3−1)² + (5−2)² + (9−3)²] = √[4+9+36] = √49 = 7 units. Equation of line PQ passing through P(1,2,3) and Q(3,5,9): direction = (3−1, 5−2, 9−3) = (2, 3, 6). Equation: (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z−3)/6.
questions.topic: Foot of perpendicular and distance from a point to a line

questions.text: एक कारपेंटर एक ऐसे घनाभाकार लकड़ी के बक्से को बनाना चाहता है कि इसकी लंबाई व चौड़ाई का योगफल इसकी ऊँचाई से 3 cm अधिक हो। इसकी लंबाई के दुगुने तथा चौड़ाई के तिगुने को ऊँचाई में जोड़ने पर 10 cm आता है। इसकी चौड़ाई को इसकी ऊँचाई के 7 गुने में जोड़ने पर इसकी लंबाई के तिगुने से 1 cm कम आता है।
questions.text_english: A carpenter needs to design a wooden box in the shape of a cuboid such that the sum of its length and breadth is 3 cm more than its height. Twice of its length, thrice of its breadth and its height add up to 10 cm. Its breadth added to 7 times its height is 1 cm less than 3 times its length.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:
questions.solution: Case study question. Answers are in sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: विभिन्न विमाओं को दर्शाते हुए समीकरणों को लिखिए तथा उन्हें आव्यूह समीकरण AX = B के रूप में व्यक्त कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the equations representing the various dimensions and express them as the matrix equation AX = B.

key_points: Let l = length, b = breadth, h = height

sub_questions.solution: Let l, b, h represent length, breadth, and height respectively. From the given conditions: l + b − h = 3 (sum of l and b is 3 more than h); 2l + 3b + h = 10 (twice l plus thrice b plus h = 10); 3l − b − 7h = 1 (3l minus b minus 7h = 1, i.e., b + 7h = 3l − 1). In matrix form AX = B: A = [[1, 1, −1], [2, 3, 1], [3, −1, −7]], X = [[l], [b], [h]], B = [[3], [10], [1]].

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या A⁻¹ का अस्तित्व है। अपने उत्तर की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find if A⁻¹ exists. Justify your answer.

key_points: Compute |A| and check if it is non-zero
Compute cofactors and transpose to get adjugate

questions.topic: System of linear equations using matrices

questions.text: एक NGO ने एक चैरिटी इवेंट आयोजित किया जिसमें उन्होंने बच्चों को सर्दी से बचाने के लिए ऊनी टोपियाँ बाँटने का फैसला किया। बाँटने वाली टोपियाँ तीन अलग-अलग बक्सों में हैं, बॉक्स I में 30 लाल रंग की टोपियाँ हैं, बॉक्स II में 20 लाल तथा 10 हरी टोपियाँ हैं, तथा बॉक्स III में 30 हरे रंग की टोपियाँ हैं। बॉक्स i चुनकर उसमें से एक टोपी लेने की प्रायिकता i/6 है, जहाँ i = 1, 2, 3 है।
questions.text_english: An NGO organises a charity event in which they decide to distribute woollen caps to protect children from winter. The caps to be distributed are in three separate boxes, Box I has 30 red caps, Box II has 20 red and 10 green caps, and Box III has 30 green caps. The probability that a Box i is selected and a cap picked out is i/6, where i = 1, 2, 3.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए : एक व्यक्ति एक टोपी चुनता है।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions: A person selects a cap.
questions.solution: Case study question. Answers are in sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: उसके एक लाल रंग की टोपी चुनने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that he selects a red cap?

key_points: P(red) = P(Box I)×P(red|Box I) + P(Box II)×P(red|Box II) + P(Box III)×P(red|Box III)

sub_questions.text: यदि वह एक हरी टोपी चुनता है, तो इस टोपी के बॉक्स II में से चुने जाने की प्रायिकता क्या है?
sub_questions.text_english: If he selects a green cap, what is the probability that the cap has come from Box II?

key_points: P(Box II | green) = P(Box II)×P(green|Box II) / P(green)

questions.text: एक बर्थडे पार्टी पर, बच्चों को शंक्वाकार कपों में संतरे का जूस दिया जा रहा था, जैसा कि आकृति में दर्शाया गया है। प्रत्येक कप की गहराई 15 cm है तथा त्रिज्या 5 cm है। इस कप में जूस 0.1 cm³/s की दर से डाला जा रहा है।
questions.text_english: At a birthday party, children are being served orange juice in conical cups, as shown in the figure. Each cup is 15 cm deep and has a radius 5 cm. The juice is being poured into this cup at a rate of 0.1 cm³/s.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions:
questions.solution: Case study question. Answers are in sub-questions.

sub_questions.text: कप में जूस की ऊँचाई h तथा कप में जूस के पृष्ठ की त्रिज्या r में संबंध स्थापित कीजिए जबकि शंकु का अर्ध-शीर्ष कोण α है।
sub_questions.text_english: Establish a relation between the height h of the juice in the cup and radius r of the surface of the juice in the cup, if the semi-vertical angle of the cone is α.
sub_questions.solution: The semi-vertical angle α satisfies tanα = R/H = 5/15 = 1/3. By similar triangles, at juice height h, the radius of the juice surface r satisfies r/h = tanα = 1/3. Therefore, r = h/3.

sub_questions.text: कप में जूस का तल किस दर से ऊपर चढ़ रहा है, जब कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है?
sub_questions.text_english: At what rate is the juice level in the cup rising when the juice is 6 cm deep?
sub_questions.solution: Using r = h/3, the volume of juice is V = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(h²/9)h = πh³/27. Differentiating: dV/dt = (π/27)×3h² (dh/dt) = (πh²/9)(dh/dt). Given dV/dt = 0.1 cm³/s and h = 6: 0.1 = (π × 36/9)(dh/dt) = 4π(dh/dt). Therefore dh/dt = 0.1/(4π) = 1/(40π) cm/s.

sub_questions.text: (क) जिस समय कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है, उस समय जूस के ऊपरी पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) When the juice is 6 cm deep, then find at what rate is the upper surface area of juice increasing?

key_points: Upper surface area S = πr² = πh²/9

sub_questions.solution: Upper surface area of juice S = πr² = π(h/3)² = πh²/9. Differentiating: dS/dt = (2πh/9)(dh/dt). At h = 6 and dh/dt = 1/(40π): dS/dt = (2π × 6/9) × (1/(40π)) = (12π/9) × (1/(40π)) = 12/(360) = 1/30 cm²/s.

sub_questions.text: (ख) जब कप में जूस की गहराई 6 cm है, उस समय कप के गीले पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (wetted surface area) के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) When the juice is 6 cm deep, then find the rate at which the wetted surface area of the cup is increasing.

key_points: Wetted surface area (lateral) = πrl where l = slant height = h√(1 + 1/9) = h√10/3

sub_questions.solution: The wetted (lateral) surface area of the conical portion with radius r and slant height l is S_w = πrl. Since r = h/3 and slant height l = √(r² + h²) = √(h²/9 + h²) = h√(10/9) = h√10/3. So S_w = π(h/3)(h√10/3) = πh²√10/9. Differentiating: dS_w/dt = (2πh√10/9)(dh/dt). At h = 6 and dh/dt = 1/(40π): dS_w/dt = (2π × 6 × √10/9)(1/(40π)) = (12π√10/9)(1/(40π)) = 12√10/360 = √10/30 cm²/s.
